summary: Student marks and attendance tracking application for Tarun Coaching Center
architectural_notes: Application designed for Tarun Coaching Center
Core functionality: marks and attendance tracking
Admin-only access controls for marks and attendance updates
Daily update capability for marks and attendance records
Test subject management system for organizing marks by subject
Authentication system switched from Google/Internet Identity to admin-controlled username/password system
Only admins can create accounts for students and staff
Credentials stored securely with password hashing in Motoko backend

existing_features.title: Create a frontend interface to add, view, edit, and delete student records
Create a frontend interface to record and view student marks
Create a frontend interface to mark and view student attendance
Design a professional, education-focused visual theme with warm, welcoming colors and clear typography that reflects an academic coaching environment
Enhance the marks recording interface to support daily updates by admin users, allowing selection from managed test subjects and updating existing mark entries
Create an admin interface for test subject management allowing admins to add new subjects and edit existing subject names
Enhance the attendance interface to support daily updates by admin users, allowing them to mark or update attendance for multiple students efficiently
Implement role-based UI rendering that shows or hides admin-only features (marks updates, test subject management, attendance updates) based on the authenticated user's role from their profile

Update the LoginPage component to use a dark color scheme with dark backgrounds, light text for headings and body copy, and properly contrasted form elements that maintain readability and accessibility

Update the LoginPage component to display two visually distinct options: 'Log In' button for existing users and 'Create Account' button for new users, both triggering the same Internet Identity authentication flow but with different button labels and visual separation to guide user understanding

Add explanatory text or helper messages near each button to clarify that 'Log In' is for returning users with existing Internet Identity accounts, and 'Create Account' guides new users through Internet Identity setup
Update the LoginPage component to display only a single 'Sign in with Google' button, removing the separate 'Log In' and 'Create Account' buttons while maintaining the dark mode styling
Remove all Internet Identity and Google authentication dependencies from the frontend, including the useInternetIdentity hook, AuthClient usage, and Internet Identity provider wrapper
Implement a traditional username/password login form on the LoginPage component replacing the 'Sign in with Google' button, with fields for username/ID and password, maintaining the dark mode styling
Create an admin-only account creation interface accessible from the Layout navigation menu, with form fields for username/ID, password, role selection (Admin/Teacher/Staff/Student), and name
Update the useAuth hook to manage username/password authentication state instead of Internet Identity, including login, logout, and session persistence functionality
Remove the ProfileSetupModal component since user profiles will be created by admins during account creation with all necessary information

new_feature_requests.summary: Track student marks
Track student attendance
Manage student records
Create a backend data model to store student information including name, roll number, class/grade, and contact details
Implement backend functionality to record and retrieve student marks for different subjects and exams
Implement backend functionality to track daily attendance records for students
Implement admin authentication and authorization system
Create admin interface to update student marks daily for different test subjects
Implement test subject management functionality (add, edit, delete subjects)
Create admin interface to update student attendance daily
Implement admin role verification in the backend to restrict mark updates, test subject management, and attendance updates to users with admin privileges only
Create backend functionality to manage test subjects including adding new subjects, editing subject names, and retrieving all available subjects
Convert login page to dark mode with dark backgrounds, light text, and contrasted form elements
Replace Google/Internet Identity authentication with username/password login system
Create admin panel interface for creating student and staff accounts with username/ID and password
Implement secure backend credential storage with password hashing in Motoko
Implement role assignment system for admin-created accounts (student/staff/admin roles)
Create backend Motoko functions to securely store user credentials with password hashing, supporting user creation with username, hashed password, role (admin/staff/student), and name fields
Implement backend authentication function that verifies username and password credentials, returns a session token or user identity on success, and supports role-based access control
Update the useActor hook to initialize the backend actor with session-based authentication instead of Internet Identity principal
Update backend migration.mo to preserve existing user profile data during the transition from Internet Identity to username/password authentication system
